connector.name: PathCourse Health (PCH)
connector.registryDescription: Cheaper LLM inference, USDC agent payments via x402, agent identity / reputation lookup.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pathcourse-health account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PCH_API_KEY
env.description: Your PCH API key (format: pch_prod_b_...). Optional — many tools work without it. Mint one via the pch_provision tool by sending 5 USDC on Base.

env.name: PCH_GATEWAY_URL
env.description: Override the PCH gateway URL. Defaults to https://gateway.pathcoursehealth.com (production mainnet).
